name: Swiss modernist corporate mark
region: Switzerland, Germany, Britain and the United States
summary: A mark for a whole organisation: a reduced symbol on a grid, one or two colours, a neo-grotesque or a custom sans logotype, and a manual that fixes every size, space and colour. Railways, airlines and state agencies led the style.

philosophy.core_thesis: A mark is a tool of a system: it must be objective, reproducible in any medium, and the same at 5 mm and at 5 m.
design_principles: Draw the symbol on a square grid of 8–16 units; every edge lands on a unit line or on a 45° step.
Use strokes of one weight, at 12–20% of the symbol height, with no contrast.
Limit the mark to 1–2 flat colours: one strong brand colour and black or white.
Set the logotype in a neo-grotesque or a custom sans, with a cap height of 35–50% of the symbol height.
Fix the lock-up of symbol and logotype in a manual, with the gap between them equal to one grid unit times 2–4.
Define clear space as a module of the mark: often the stroke width times 2, or half the symbol height.
anti_patterns: More than 2 colours in the master mark
A mark redrawn by hand for each use

construction.grid: A square grid of 8–16 units over the symbol; arcs have centres on grid points and radii of whole units.
construction.geometry: Straight lines at 0°, 45° and 90°, and arcs from a compass; no freehand curve.
construction.stroke_rule: One stroke weight at 12–20% of the symbol height for all parts of the symbol.
construction.symmetry: Rotational or mirror symmetry is common; a directional mark uses two opposed arrows of equal weight.
construction.detail_floor: No gap under 6% of the symbol height, so the mark prints at 5 mm and on a rail car.

form.silhouette: A symbol that fits a square or a 2:1 rectangle, locked up left of or above a horizontal logotype.
form.letterforms: A neo-grotesque sans (Helvetica class) or a custom monoline sans in medium to bold weight, upper and lower case or all capitals, with tracking from 0 to 5%.

colour.strategy: One saturated brand colour, red, blue or yellow, with black or white; the mark also works in one colour on any ground.
colour.reversal_rule: The master mark is one colour, so white on the brand colour and black on white are both standard versions.

reproduction.clear_space: Half the symbol height on each side, as fixed in the graphics manual.
reproduction.media: Offset print, signs, vehicle livery, uniforms and timetables; later the screen.

emotion.target_response: Confidence in a system: the viewer trusts that the organisation runs on time and on rules.

avoid_when: The brief asks for warmth, craft or a personal voice.
The product sells on nostalgia or luxury.

modifiers.how: Keep the grid and the flat colour; make the symbol one heavy abstract shape with no logotype beside it.
Keep the sans and the one colour; drop the symbol and let the word carry the mark.
